$comment: Shell-owned action an MFE executes against the domain it is mounted in (the screen or the overlay domain) to go to a place: an organization, a workspace in it, or a project in that workspace — what Search finds. The shell opens the deepest level named on its entry screen and moves the address as a pick in the path bar does. See placeOpen in contextActions.ts.

workspaceId.$comment: Optional: the workspace level; required for a project, whose address names its workspace.
